CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
July 9, 2019 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

CALL TO ORDER

5.
PUBLIC COMMENT
6.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
PROCLAMATION FOR PARKS AND RECREATION MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim July 2019 as Parks and Recreation Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Community Services Director Oliver Osuna.
6.1 Proclamation for Parks and Recreation Month
6.2
RECOGNITION OF CITY EMPLOYEE FOR YEARS OF SERVICE - It is recommended the City Council recognize Mary Cipres for her years of service and present her with a service award pin and a certificate of appreciation.
6.2 Recognition of City Employee
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
APPOINTMENT OF OFFICERS TO THE LA MIRADA COMMUNITY FOUNDATION - It is recommended the City Council confirm the appointments of Jim Zoellner as President and John Grotz as Vice President of the Board of Directors of the La Mirada Community Foundation.
7.1 Appointments to the La Mirada Community Foundation
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular meeting of June 25, 2019.
8.1 Minutes
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated July 9, 2019 in the total amount of $1,960,803.28.
8.2 Warrant Register
8.3
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-09, SLURRY SEALING AND SIGNING AND STRIPING PLANS FOR BIOLA AVENUE, STAGE ROAD, ESCALONA ROAD, FOSTER ROAD, ADELFA DRIVE AND ALICANTE ROAD - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15101, Class (C) and will have no significant adverse effect on the environment; approve the plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2018-09, Slurry Sealing and Signing and Striping Plans for Biola Avenue, Stage Road, Escalona Road, Foster Road, Adelfa Drive, and Alicante Road; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
8.3 CIP No. 2018-09
8.4
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2019-03, NEIGHBORHOOD SLURRY SEAL - AREA 1 (FOSTER PARK AREA), IMPERIAL HIGHWAY, NEARGROVE ROAD, JALISCO ROAD, FLORITA ROAD, CRESTOAK DRIVE, GARA DRIVE, ASHGROVE DRIVE, EXCELSIOR DRIVE, NEARTREE ROAD, BLUEFIELD AVENUE, STANLEAF DRIVE, FIGUERAS ROAD, SAN BRUNO DRIVE - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15101, Class (C) and will have no significant adverse effect on the environment; approve the plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2019-03, Neighborhood Slurry Seal - Area 1 (Foster Park Area), Imperial Highway, Neargrove Road, Jalisco Road, Florita Road, Crestoak Drive, Gara Drive, Ashgrove Drive, Excelsior Drive, Neartree Road, Bluefield Avenue, Stanleaf Drive, Figueras Road, San Bruno Drive; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
8.4 CIP No. 2019-03
8.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2017-04, STREET NAME SIGN REPLACEMENT PROGRAM - REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2017-04, Street Name Sign Replacement Program, to Safety Network Traffic Signs, Inc. in the amount of $419,450; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the existing on-call engineering contracts for construction support services in an amount not to exceed ten percent of the construction cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project cost including construction and inspection.
8.5 CIP No. 2017-04
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 19-22 AUTHORIZING THE REMOVAL OF RED LIGHT VIOLATION FINE SIGNS AT DESIGNATED SIGNALIZED INTERSECTIONS - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-22 authorizing the removal of Red Light Violation Fine signs at the designated locations.
9.1 Resolution No. 19-22
